video:video.video:description: Activists gathered in Kenya's capital of Nairobi on Thursday to demand the release of Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye, a day after he collapsed in court in Kampala.

video:video.video:description: Israelis across political and religious lines are worried about the weakening connection with younger Jewish Americans — whom a recent AP poll showed tend to consider support for Israel less crucial to their Jewish identity than older adults.
